question: Approve the revised ideation of worker-knows-the-team-and-asks-early to enter implementation? FO recommends approve; approving accepts that recommendation and both decisions as recommended: D1 new-work-checks-what-exists-first follows as its own task rather than merging in; D2 the workflow word budget rises by exactly 144 words, 5421 to 5565, for one Team bullet under Dispatch facts that every worker stage reads.

artifacts.summary: Revised after interview round 2 (5 FOs). The 144-word Team bullet names which records to check (prior reports, linked sibling tasks and PRs, workflow state), tells a worker to say first when its environment cannot run a required check, to pause dependent work only when it has a mid-run FO channel and otherwise end its turn with the handback, and never to answer its own or its reviewers' permission requests. Round 2: qnow 3, relay 2, kc-paseo 1 and web 1 (partly) worker events would have changed. Worse: every worker and README load is 144 words longer; text does not prove behaviour (AC-6 ends in accept, repair or stop). Needs an ADR number at implementation.
